request.intent: Explain how LiminalOSAI can strengthen an AI assistant without overstating the project's capabilities

draft.response: LiminalOSAI can act as an external deterministic evidence and action gate, but it cannot modify model weights or become a production safety boundary by itself.

claims.text: The repository contains a deterministic advisory adapter with explicit no-authority boundaries.
The project does not claim to be a production OS, AGI, or production safety enforcement layer.
A deterministic external gate can improve longitudinal reliability without changing the underlying model weights.
